# artisanvirt Provider

The Artisan Virt provider manages hypervisor nodes, clusters, virtual machines, host bridges and backups through the Artisan Virt control plane REST API (`/api/v1`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    artisanvirt = {
      source  = "developerprince-eng/artisanvirt"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and token can also come from ARTISANVIRT_ENDPOINT and
# ARTISANVIRT_TOKEN, which keeps the admin token out of configuration files.
provider "artisanvirt" {
  endpoint = "https://artisan.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate trusted in addition to the system roots. Env: `ARTISANVIRT_CA_CERT`.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the control plane, for example `https://artisan.example.com`. Can also be set with the `ARTISANVIRT_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification (lab installs only). Env: `ARTISANVIRT_INSECURE`.
- `poll_interval` (Number) Seconds between polls while waiting for asynchronous tasks. Defaults to `3`.
- `request_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for a single HTTP request. Defaults to `60`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Administrator bearer token. Can also be set with the `ARTISANVIRT_TOKEN` environment variable.
